workflow.name: Locked continuation-soup-v1 actor panels
workflow.failing_step: Build and bind one immutable evaluator artifact

failure_classification.detail: The exact launch guard and source checkout passed, compilation completed, and the first post-build assertion rejected the rebuilt arena because its SHA-256 did not equal the predeclared a65f7387 digest. The locked binary used binutils 2.42-4ubuntu2.5; the floating runner image used 2.42-4ubuntu2.10.
failure_classification.repair: Transport the already locked arena, root model, and candidate model as exact repository objects; verify their sizes and SHA-256 digests before artifact assembly and before every shard; and compile nothing on the evaluation runner.

statistical_disposition.reason: No actor job started and no efficacy-bearing output or artifact existed.
